plugins.name: personal-skills
plugins.description: Shared personal skills for Claude Desktop, Cowork, and Claude Code.

plugins.name: complexity-lens
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: complexity, density and hotspot score above the prompt for files Claude reads or edits. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: one line above the prompt with context fill, five-hour and weekly plan-limit use, and prompt-cache use with a countdown to expiry; /meter adds per-turn and per-subagent usage. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: nested-agents-md
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: loads nested AGENTS.md for files Claude touches through Bash, Edit or Write; the built-in agents-md mod loads them only on Read. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: done-gate
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: blocks the end of a turn while guarded code differs from the working tree that last passed the repository's check command (configured in .claude/done-gate.json). Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: explore-model
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: runs the built-in Explore subagent on a chosen model and effort (default Haiku, medium) when the Agent call names none. Claude only; needs function hooks.

plugins.name: issue-hygiene-reminder
plugins.description: Claude Code and Codex hook: before a GitHub issue write (gh issue create/edit/close/comment, gh api on issues, GitHub MCP issue writes), adds a one-paragraph reminder of the issue-hygiene rules. Never blocks.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Run an adversarial Codex review from Claude Code, Cursor, or Grok Build through one launcher: the repository stays read-only, heredocs, git and gh work, and the run is watched for timeout, stall, and an expired login. Not for Codex itself.
